**Choices I made where the description is unclear:**
- I read the lexicon numbers as raw votes that are then doubled, so a negation adds +12 to contradiction.
- A conflict counts whenever the premise has a different member of the group, even if it also has the same word.
- The first word of the premise is never matched, because nothing comes before it.
